requirements: ownedRelationship and owningRelatedElement are reciprocal; ownedRelationship preserves order.
owningRelationship identifies the relationship containing an element in ownedRelatedElement.
Element.owner derives through owningRelationship.owningRelatedElement, rather than identifying the containing relationship itself.
owningNamespace derives through owningMembership. A direct child of a non-owning membership or import does not acquire namespace membership by containment alone.
qualifiedName requires an unbroken chain of named owning namespaces. Internal resolver keys do not establish that chain.

verification_scope: Initial construction of two Ecore containment pairs and direct KerML alias/import children; does not qualify all Element operations, mutation or cycle handling.
